lines.sub: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson thirteen — “Money by voice”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson thirteen — Money by voice.

lines.sub: Where did the money go this month? The receipts are lost, and opening a budgeting app is too much effort.
lines.tts: Where did the money go this month? The receipts are lost, and opening a budgeting app is too much effort.

lines.sub: Just say: “Spent twelve hundred on groceries.”
lines.tts: Just say: Spent twelve hundred on groceries.

lines.sub: I'll record the expense and sort it into categories myself.
lines.tts: I'll record the expense and sort it into categories myself.

lines.sub: And income: “Got my salary, eighty thousand.”
lines.tts: And income: Got my salary, eighty thousand.

lines.sub: Ask: “How much did I spend on cafés in October?” — I'll count it exactly, not in my head.
lines.tts: Ask: How much did I spend on cafés in October? — I'll count it exactly, not in my head.

lines.sub: At the start of the month — “My month”: where the money went, big and clear.
lines.tts: At the start of the month — My month: where the money went, big and clear.

lines.sub: A shared budget with your family: everyone you invited sees the spending.
lines.tts: A shared budget with your family: everyone you invited sees the spending.

lines.sub: In the studio: “Calendar” → “Money”. On the phone: “My day” → “Money”.
lines.tts: In the studio: Calendar, Money. On the phone: My day, Money.
